name: mailbox
description: Scoped IMAP/SMTP access over HTTP and MCP: read, organize, draft, reply and send mail.

mailbox_url.title: mailboxd URL
mailbox_url.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd instance, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (sets MAILBOX_URL).

mailbox_token.title: mailboxd bearer token
mailbox_token.description: Bearer token matching the server's auth.tokens (sets MAILBOX_TOKEN).
